limitations: Examples are hand-written by the project team, so the held-out test set measures generalisation to new wording of the SAME topics, not to real patient language.
With ~10 questions per topic the validation and test sets contain only 1-2 groups per class; metrics have wide uncertainty.
Labels are topic ids, not clinically validated diagnoses.
